fields.System.Title: OUT-202 — Handle partial allocation and backorder
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want partly available lines handled explicitly, so that
downstream code always knows what state an order is in.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a customer who allows partial shipment and partial stock, then the available
  • quantity is allocated and the remainder becomes an explicit backorder.
  • - Given a customer who does not allow partial shipment, then nothing is allocated and
  • the order waits whole.
  • - Given a backordered quantity, then it is a modelled state, not merely "unallocated".
  • - Given stock arriving later, then backordered lines are re-evaluated automatically.
  • - Given a partly allocated order, then its status distinguishes it from both fully
  • allocated and unallocated.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | order_line, allocation |
| Risks | Ambiguous partial state that downstream code does not handle ([doc 05 WF 4](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
